SMTO-GWT-0072 — SMTO can't split this GPU into MIG instances

GUID: cee8e0bf-33a2-50a9-945d-13e78d3c0987
Slug: gpu-mig-unsupported
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gpu

What happened

  • MIG lets some NVIDIA cards be divided into several smaller GPUs. SMTO's GPU skill can show whether MIG is on, but it can't change MIG settings. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, ask SMTO to show the details for this GPU. The details say whether MIG is currently on, so you can see how the card is set up now.
  2. Ask the person who manages that computer to set up MIG instances with NVIDIA's own tools. Dividing a card into MIG instances isn't something SMTO's GPU skill can do.

What success looks like

  • After the administrator makes the change, the GPU details in SMTO show the MIG setting you wanted.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the computer with the GPU. Don't keep asking SMTO to try; it has no way to change MIG settings.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • MIG partition configuration was requested, but the GPU skill exposes no MIG configuration operation (legacy kind gpu.mig_unsupported; mig_configuration is always false and no current code path emits it).

What this means

  • The catalog retains a MIG-configuration-unavailable identity. The current typed GPU schema exposes no MIG partition mutation, and has no direct branch that emits this identity. The current operation schema supports telemetry and selected configuration only; this definition does not add MIG mutation support.

Why this can happen

  • The catalog retains a MIG-configuration-unavailable identity. The current typed GPU schema exposes no MIG partition mutation, and has no direct branch that emits this identity.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested action with the discovered GPU schema and supported MIG telemetry; do not translate it into arbitrary provider arguments.

How to fix it

  • Use gpu.device to read mig_mode for the UUID; create or change MIG instances with NVIDIA's own tooling on the Gateway host, outside the SMTO GPU skill, which supports only telemetry and the listed configuration operations.
  • Inspect MIG telemetry; instance partitioning requires a separate supported workflow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect MIG telemetry; instance partitioning requires a separate supported workflow.

How to verify the fix

  • The unsupported action is kept outside this tool, or a separately supported and authorized workflow handles it.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, kill GPU clients automatically or invent sensor values.

Technical notes

  • The current operation schema supports telemetry and selected configuration only; this definition does not add MIG mutation support.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
